{{Quote|The Reign of the Ax lasted three centuries, while Adas sustained his life energy with the dark side. He was worshipped as the ''Sith'ari'', or god of the Sith. Only when the great Rakatan conquerors arrived did his life end.|Sorzus Syn, ''Chronicle of Sorzus Syn''|<ref name="BoS" />}}
The '''Reign of the Ax''' was an era of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the history of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]]. It corresponded to the reign of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Adas]], which lasted three hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]]<ref name="BoS" /> (circa [[28,000 BBY]] to [[27,700 BBY]]).<ref name="JvS" /> It ended with the King's [[Death/Legends|death]], while he was trying to [[Invasion of Korriban|drive off]] the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]].<ref name="BoS" /> The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ikoral]] belonged to an [[Darth Ikoral's lineage|old line]] that dated as far back as King Adas's time.<ref name="Ikoral codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Darth Ikoral}}</ref> Following the [[Discovery of Korriban]] in [[6900 BBY]],<ref name="JvS" /> ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] wrote about King Adas's reign in [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|chronicle]], which was later collected by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] into his ''[[Book of Sith]]''.<ref name="BoS" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exploration Corps/Legends|ExplorCorps]] member [[Malleus|Telloti Cillmam'n]] found the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Warb Null]] on [[Nicht Ka]], an [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]]-washed world located on the border of the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. After donning the armor, Cillmam'n was flooded with visions of the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] history, including the Rakatan invasion of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Hammer">{{InsiderCite|147|Hammer (short story)}}</ref>
